scenario: Two editor sessions save the same visual draft ETag

loser_ux.message: A newer draft was saved elsewhere. Your local layout is preserved. Reload the server draft to refresh the revision token, or adopt the server version.

actions.label: Reload server draft
actions.effect: Fetches latest Page/ETag; keeps local layout dirty so Save can overwrite with If-Match refresh

actions.label: Adopt server draft
actions.effect: Replaces local layout with server tree, clears dirty/undo, no silent merge
